summary: This WebGoat training application contains 11 security vulnerabilities: 7 SQL injections, 2 XSS flaws, and 2 outdated dependencies with known CVEs. Most critical is the commons-collections RCE vulnerability (CVE-2015-6420) which should be patched immediately, followed by the SQL injection in UserService that affects core authentication, while the XStream vulnerability should remain unfixed as it serves an educational purpose in demonstrating deserialization attacks.
